+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+    text = text.replace("\\", "")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):

+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):

+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False

+    except OSError:

+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+        return None

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def cmd_set_status(env: Env, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    manifest = load_manifest(env)

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+def render_phase_a_modality_prompts(env: Env, stages: list[str], prefix: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict[str, str]:
+    ensure_tree(env)
+    stages = [f"{int(s):03d}" for s in stages]

+            env.rel(env.config_path_value("atlas_graph")),

+    )
+    common = {
+        "STAGES": ", ".join(stages),
+        "SOURCE_FILES": yaml_block(source_files),

+        "graph": "phase_a_graph.md",
+        "existing_provenance": "phase_a_existing_provenance.md",
+    }
+    rendered: dict[str, str] = {}

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

def now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def slug(text: str) -> str:
    out = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text).strip("_").lower()
    return out or "item"


def load_yaml(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.exists():
        return {}
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return yaml.safe_load(f) or {}


def write_yaml(path: Path, data: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    with tmp.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        yaml.dump(data, f, Dumper=NoAliasDumper, default_flow_style=False, sort_keys=False, width=120, allow_unicode=True)
    tmp.replace(path)


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(path)


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
     query_graph = env.config_path_value("query_graph")
     graph_path = env.config_path_value("atlas_graph")
+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

def load_manifest(env: Env) -> dict[str, Any]:
    m = load_yaml(env.manifest_path)
    if not m:
        return initial_manifest(env)
    m.setdefault("state_machine", STATE_MACHINE)
    m.setdefault("candidates", {})
    m.setdefault("dry_runs", {})
    return m


def save_manifest(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    manifest["updated_at"] = now_iso()
    write_yaml(env.manifest_path, manifest)


def transition(entry: dict[str, Any], status: str) -> None:
    if status not in STATE_MACHINE:
        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {status}")
    entry["status"] = status
    entry.setdefault("status_timestamps", {})[status] = now_iso()

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

def pass2_report_path(env: Env, stage: str) -> Path:
    pattern = nested_get(env.adv, "phase_a_seeds.pass2_stage_reports_glob")
    if not pattern:
        return env.project_root / f"redteam/pass2/reports/stage_{int(stage):03d}.md"
    return env.resolve_project_path(pattern.format(stage=f"{int(stage):03d}"))


def checkpoint_provenance_path(env: Env) -> Path:
    return env.config_path_value("phase_a_seeds.checkpoint_provenance")


def has_fit_signal(text: str) -> bool:
    lower = text.lower()
    if any(keyword in lower for keyword in CLAIM_KEYWORDS):
        return True
    return bool(
        re.search(
            r"(?i)\b(?:value|constant|scalar|parameter|coefficient|normalization|branch|benchmark)\b.*\b(?:is|=|:=|yields|gives|becomes)\b",
            text,
        )
    )


def mentioned_stage(text: str, stages: list[str]) -> str | None:
    for stage in stages:
        n = int(stage)
        patterns = [
            rf"(?i)stage[\s_~`:-]*0*{n}(?!\d)",
        ]
        if any(re.search(pattern, text) for pattern in patterns):
            return f"{n:03d}"
    return None


def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")


def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
    text = text.strip().strip("`")
    text = text.replace("\\", "")
    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
    text = text.replace("^", "_")
    text = clean_param_piece(text)
    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
        return None
    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
        return None

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def cmd_set_status(env: Env, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    manifest = load_manifest(env)
+    entry = (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).get(args.candidate_id)
+    if not entry:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: unknown candidate: {args.candidate_id}")
+    current = entry.get("status")
+    validate_manual_transition(current, args.status)
+    transition(entry, args.status)
+    if args.note:
+        entry.setdefault("status_notes", []).append({"status": args.status, "note": args.note, "at": now_iso()})
+    manifest["candidates"][args.candidate_id] = entry
+    render_fit_file(env, manifest)
+    render_batches(env, manifest)
+    save_manifest(env, manifest)
+    print(yaml_block({"candidate_id": args.candidate_id, "from": current, "to": args.status}))

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")
+
+
+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text
+
+
+def add_param(params: list[str], value: str | None) -> None:
+    if value and value not in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        params.append(value)
+
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    text = text.replace("\\", "")

+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:
+                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")
+
+
+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text
+

+        params.append(value)

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def render_phase_a_modality_prompts(env: Env, stages: list[str], prefix: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict[str, str]:
+    ensure_tree(env)

+    )

+        "PASS2_STAGE_REPORTS": yaml_block(phase_a_stage_reports(env, stages)),
+        "CHECKPOINT_PROVENANCE": env.rel(checkpoint_provenance_path(env)),

+    }
+    templates = {
+        "numeric_literal": "phase_a_numeric_literal.md",
+        "claim_label": "phase_a_claim_label.md",
+        "graph": "phase_a_graph.md",
+        "existing_provenance": "phase_a_existing_provenance.md",
+    }
+    rendered: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for modality, template in templates.items():

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

 ### Phase A Scan
 
+For Step 3 real campaign work, do not hand-select a family of stages or parameters. The real sweep is the full configured stage range, currently 001 through 253. Render the blind prompts for the campaign band first:
+
+```bash
+$AA render-phase-a-prompts --stages $(seq -f "%03g" 1 253) --prefix campaign_001_253
+```

The mechanical `phase-a-scan` path is broad and not seeded to any parameter family; it provides the union baseline and records per-modality attribution. +def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():

+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def cmd_set_status(env: Env, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
+    manifest = load_manifest(env)
+    entry = (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).get(args.candidate_id)
+    if not entry:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")
+
+
+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})

+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:

+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue

+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+
