+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
     query_graph = env.config_path_value("query_graph")
     graph_path = env.config_path_value("atlas_graph")
+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():

+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):

+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
     query_graph = env.config_path_value("query_graph")
     graph_path = env.config_path_value("atlas_graph")
+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):

+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:

+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:
+        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")
+
+
+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")

+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():

+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):

+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:

+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:
+                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:
+        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")

+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():

+    return text

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+
+

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
+            continue
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:
+                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids
+
+
+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:
+        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+        return False

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def render_phase_a_modality_prompts(env: Env, stages: list[str], prefix: str, dry_run: bool = False) -> dict[str, str]:
+    ensure_tree(env)
+    stages = [f"{int(s):03d}" for s in stages]
+    source_files = stage_source_context(env, stages)
+    graph_cmd = " ".join(
+        [
+            "timeout",
+            "600",
+            "python3",
+            env.rel(env.config_path_value("query_graph")),
+            "--graph",
+            env.rel(env.config_path_value("atlas_graph")),
+        ]
+    )
+    common = {
+        "STAGES": ", ".join(stages),
+        "SOURCE_FILES": yaml_block(source_files),
+        "PASS2_RECONCILIATION": env.rel(env.config_path_value("phase_a_seeds.pass2_reconciliation")),
+        "PASS2_STAGE_REPORTS": yaml_block(phase_a_stage_reports(env, stages)),
+        "CHECKPOINT_PROVENANCE": env.rel(checkpoint_provenance_path(env)),
+        "GRAPH_WRAPPER": graph_cmd,
+    }
+    templates = {
+        "numeric_literal": "phase_a_numeric_literal.md",
+        "claim_label": "phase_a_claim_label.md",
+        "graph": "phase_a_graph.md",
+        "existing_provenance": "phase_a_existing_provenance.md",
+    }
+    rendered: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for modality, template in templates.items():
+        prompt = render_template(env, template, common)
+        if dry_run:
+            prompt = "dry_run: true\nnon_binding: true\n\n" + prompt
+        path = env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts" / f"{prefix}_phase_a_{modality}.md"
+        write_text(path, prompt)
+        rendered[modality] = env.rel(path)
+    return rendered

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):

+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
+            continue
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:
+                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:
+        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
+            continue
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:
+                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids
+
+
+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:
+        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)

+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():

+        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):

+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):

+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False

+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+            continue

+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():

+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])

+                continue

+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:

+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")

+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
+        data = load_yaml(path)
+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
+            continue
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
+            try:
+                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")
+
+
+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text
+

+    if value and value not in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        params.append(value)
