+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

   368	def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
   369	    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
   370	        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
   371	    current = current or "pending"
   372	    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
   373	        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
   374	    if target == current:
   375	        return
   376	    if target == "blocked":
   377	        return
   378	    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
   379	    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
   380	    if target_i == current_i + 1:
   381	        return
   382	    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")

   385	def source_files_for_stage(env: Env, stage: str) -> list[tuple[str, Path]]:
   386	    stage = f"{int(stage):03d}"
   387	    paths: list[tuple[str, Path]] = []
   388	    candidates = [
   389	        ("paper_stage_tex", env.project_root / f"paper/stages/stage_{stage}.tex"),
   390	    ]
   391	    for role, path in candidates:
   392	        if path.exists():
   393	            paths.append((role, path))
   394	    for path in sorted((env.project_root / "notes/stages").glob(f"moving_throat_pde_stage{stage}_*.md")):
   395	        paths.append(("notes_stage", path))
   396	    for path in sorted((env.project_root / "scripts").glob(f"moving_throat_pde_stage{stage}_*_sympy_audit.py")):
   397	        paths.append(("sympy_script", path))
   398	    for path in sorted((env.project_root / "mathematica").glob(f"moving_throat_pde_stage{stage}_*_mathematica_audit.wl")):
   399	        paths.append(("mathematica_script", path))
   400	    return paths

   414	def has_fit_signal(text: str) -> bool:
   415	    lower = text.lower()
   416	    if any(keyword in lower for keyword in CLAIM_KEYWORDS):
   417	        return True
   418	    return bool(
   419	        re.search(
   420	            r"(?i)\b(?:value|constant|scalar|parameter|coefficient|normalization|branch|benchmark)\b.*\b(?:fixed|matched|matching|determined|pinned|not free)\b",
   421	            text,
   422	        )
   423	    )
   424	
   425	
   426	def is_scaffolding_line(text: str) -> bool:
   427	    lower = text.lower()
   428	    markers = (
   429	        "\\stagefield{purpose}",
   430	        "\\stagefield{downstream use}",
   431	        "\\stagefield{verification}",
   432	        "\\claimstatus",
   433	        "\\section",
   434	        "documentation index-garble",
   435	        "paper_misalignment",
   436	        "deliverable forms checked",
   437	        "not a fully solved",
   438	        "resolve before fix_loop",
   439	    )
   440	    return any(marker in lower for marker in markers)

   442	
   443	def mentioned_stage(text: str, stages: list[str]) -> str | None:
   444	    for stage in stages:
   445	        n = int(stage)
   446	        patterns = [
   447	            rf"(?i)stage[\s_~`:-]*0*{n}(?!\d)",
   448	        ]
   449	        if any(re.search(pattern, text) for pattern in patterns):
   450	            return f"{n:03d}"
   451	    return None
   452	
   453	
   454	def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
   455	    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
   456	    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
   457	    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
   458	    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")
   459	
   460	
   461	def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
   462	    text = text.strip().strip("`")
   463	    text = text.replace("\\", "")
   464	    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
   465	    text = text.replace("^", "_")
   466	    text = clean_param_piece(text)
   467	    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
   468	        return None
   469	    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
   470	        return None
   471	    return text
   472	
   473	
   474	def add_param(params: list[str], value: str | None) -> None:
   475	    if value and value not in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
   476	        params.append(value)
   477	
   478	
   479	def detect_parameters(text: str) -> list[str]:
   480	    params: list[str] = []
   481	    for match in re.finditer(r"`([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:_[A-Za-z0-9]+)+)`", text):
   482	        add_param(params, normalized_param_name(match.group(1)))
   483	    for match in re.finditer(r"\b([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(?:_[A-Za-z0-9]+)+)\b", text):
   484	        add_param(params, normalized_param_name(match.group(1)))
   485	    for match in re.finditer(r"\\([A-Za-z]+)(?:_\{?([^}\s^]+)\}?)?", text):
   486	        command, subscript = match.groups()
   487	        if command in TEX_COMMAND_DENYLIST:
   488	            continue
   489	        if not subscript and command in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
   490	            continue
   491	        if subscript:
   492	            add_param(params, normalized_param_name(f"{command}_{subscript}"))
   493	        elif command not in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
   494	            add_param(params, normalized_param_name(command))
   495	    if re.search(r"(?:\\chi_Q|chi_Q|chiQ)\b", text):
   496	        params.append("chi_Q")
   497	    if re.search(r"(?:\\xi_Q|xi_Q|xiQ)\b", text):
   498	        params.append("xi_Q")
   499	    if re.search(r"(?:\\sigma_Q|sigma_Q|sigmaQ)\b", text):
   500	        params.append("sigma_Q")
   501	    if re.search(r"\\Gamma_\{?5", text) or "Gamma_5" in text:
   502	        params.append("Gamma_5")
   503	    return sorted(set(params))
   504	
   505	
   506	def candidate_parameters(text: str) -> list[str]:
   507	    params = detect_parameters(text)
   508	    lower = text.lower()
   509	    has_dtn = "dtn" in lower or "fingerprint" in lower
   510	    has_value = bool(re.search(r"(\\frac\{|\d+\s*/\s*\d+|\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b|=)", text))
   511	    is_value_claim = has_fit_signal(text)
   512	    if has_dtn and has_value and is_value_claim:
   513	        params.append("outgoing_l2_DtN_fingerprint")
   514	    if params and is_value_claim:
   515	        return sorted(set(params))
   516	    return []
   517	
   518	
   519	def candidate_key_for(stage: str, text: str) -> str:
   520	    params = candidate_parameters(text)
   521	    if params:
   522	        return f"stage_{int(stage):03d}_{slug(params[0])}"
   523	    raise ValueError("cannot create candidate without parameter/value class")
   524

   526	def dry_run_fixture_group_key(frag: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
   527	    """Fixture-only grouping for the mandated 104/105 chi_Q dry-run episode."""
   528	    params = set(frag.get("parameter_names") or [])
   529	    citation = frag.get("citation") or {}
   530	    text = str(citation.get("excerpt") or "").lower()
   531	    has_chi_episode_param = bool(params & {"chi_Q", "Gamma_5", "sigma_Q", "outgoing_l2_DtN_fingerprint"})
   532	    if has_chi_episode_param and ("dtn" in text or "fingerprint" in text or "chi" in text or "sigma" in text):
   533	        return "chi_q_outgoing_dtn"
   534	    return str(frag["candidate_key"])

   537	def make_fragment(
   538	    env: Env,
   539	    *,
   540	    modality: str,
   541	    stage: str,
   542	    role: str,
   543	    path: Path,
   544	    line: int,
   545	    text: str,
   546	    reason: str,
   547	) -> dict[str, Any]:
   548	    params = candidate_parameters(text)
   549	    if not params:
   550	        raise ValueError("cannot create fragment without parameter/value class")
   551	    return {
   552	        "candidate_key": candidate_key_for(stage, text),
   553	        "modality": modality,
   554	        "anchor_stage": f"{int(stage):03d}",
   555	        "parameter_names": params,
   556	        "reason": reason,
   557	        "citation": {
   558	            "path": env.rel(path),
   559	            "line": line,
   560	            "role": role,
   790	        for param in frag.get("parameter_names") or []:
   791	            if param not in entry["parameter_names"]:
   792	                entry["parameter_names"].append(param)
   793	        if frag["modality"] not in entry["modality_attribution"]:
   794	            entry["modality_attribution"].append(frag["modality"])
   795	        cit = frag.get("citation")
   796	        if cit and cit not in entry["citations"]:
   797	            entry["citations"].append(cit)
   798	        entry["modality_fragments"].append(frag)
   799	    out = []
   800	    for key, entry in grouped.items():
   801	        entry["anchor_stages"] = sorted(entry["anchor_stages"])
   802	        entry["parameter_names"] = sorted(entry["parameter_names"]) or ["unclassified_target_parameter"]
   803	        entry["modality_attribution"] = sorted(entry["modality_attribution"])
   804	        prefix = f"dryrun_{dry_run_id}_" if dry_run else "fit_"
   805	        entry["id"] = prefix + key
   806	        out.append(entry)
   807	    out.sort(key=lambda item: item["id"])
   808	    return out

   853	def render_fit_file(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any], stage_results: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
   854	    candidates = []
   855	    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
   856	        candidates.append(
   857	            {
   858	                "id": entry["id"],
   859	                "dry_run": entry.get("dry_run", False),
   860	                "dry_run_id": entry.get("dry_run_id"),
   861	                "anchor_stages": entry.get("anchor_stages", []),
   862	                "parameter_names": entry.get("parameter_names", []),
   863	                "status": entry.get("status"),
   864	                "file_line_citations": entry.get("file_line_citations", []),
   865	                "modality_attribution": entry.get("modality_attribution", []),
   866	                "batch_id": entry.get("batch_id"),
   867	            }
   868	        )
   869	    candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item["id"])
   870	    if stage_results is None:
   871	        stage_results = {}
   872	        for dry_run in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).values():
   873	            stage_results.update(dry_run.get("stage_results") or {})
   874	    payload = {
   875	        "schema_version": 1,
   876	        "generated_at": now_iso(),
   877	        "dry_run_artifacts_present": any(c.get("dry_run") for c in candidates),
   878	        "stage_results": stage_results or {},
   879	        "candidates": candidates,
   880	    }
   881	    write_yaml(env.fit_path, payload)

   884	def render_batches(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   885	    counts = defaultdict(int)
   886	    dry_counts = defaultdict(int)
   887	    verdict_count = 0
   888	    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
   889	        counts[entry.get("status", "unknown")] += 1
   890	        if entry.get("dry_run"):
   891	            dry_counts[entry.get("status", "unknown")] += 1
   892	        verdict = entry.get("verdict") or {}
   893	        if verdict.get("adversarial") or verdict.get("adjudication"):
   894	            verdict_count += 1
   895	    lines = [
   896	        "# Adversarial Audit Status",
   897	        "",
   898	        f"Generated: {now_iso()}",
   899	        f"Project: {manifest.get('project_name', '?')}",
   900	        "",
   901	        "| Scope | Counts |",
   902	        "|---|---|",
   903	        f"| all candidates | {' '.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in sorted(counts.items())) or 'none'} |",
   904	        f"| dry-run candidates | {' '.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in sorted(dry_counts.items())) or 'none'} |",
   905	        f"| binding verdict fields populated | {verdict_count} |",
   906	        "",
   907	        "Phase C batches are intentionally unset until the Step 3 batching consult.",
   908	    ]
   909	    write_text(env.batches_path, "\n".join(lines) + "\n")

  1101	def source_evidence_for_candidate(env: Env, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  1102	    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  1103	    params = [str(p) for p in entry.get("parameter_names") or []]
  1104	    param_needles = {p for p in params}
  1105	    param_needles.update(p.replace("_", "\\_") for p in params)
  1106	    param_needles.update(p.replace("_", "") for p in params)
  1107	    for stage in entry.get("anchor_stages", []):
  1108	        for role, path in source_files_for_stage(env, stage):
  1109	            if role not in {"notes_stage", "sympy_script", "paper_stage_tex"}:
  1110	                continue
  1111	            for line_no, line in iter_file_lines(path):
  1112	                mentions_param = any(needle and needle in line for needle in param_needles)
  1113	                if not mentions_param and not has_fit_signal(line) and "Stage 87" not in line and "Stage 104" not in line:
  1114	                    continue
  1115	                evidence.append(
  1116	                    {
  1117	                        "path": env.rel(path),
  1118	                        "line": line_no,
  1119	                        "role": role,
  1120	                        "excerpt": line.strip(),
  1121	                    }
  1122	                )
  1123	    return evidence[:40]

  1126	def graph_context_for_candidate(env: Env, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1127	    contexts = []
  1128	    gaps = []
  1129	    seen_sources: set[tuple[str, ...]] = set()
  1130	    for citation in entry.get("file_line_citations", []):
  1131	        if citation.get("role") not in {"notes_stage", "paper_stage_tex"}:
  1132	            continue
  1133	        query = citation.get("path")
  1134	        if not query:
  1135	            continue
  1136	        role = str(citation.get("role"))
  1137	        stage = str(citation.get("stage") or (entry.get("anchor_stages") or ["0"])[0])
  1138	        source_path = env.abs_from_rel(str(query))
  1139	        source_queries = source_query_variants(env, source_path, role, stage)
  1140	        key = tuple(source_queries)
  1141	        if key in seen_sources:
  1142	            continue
  1143	        seen_sources.add(key)
  1144	        nodes, errors = query_graph_source(env, source_queries)
  1145	        if not nodes:
  1146	            gaps.append(
  1147	                {
  1148	                    "source": query,
  1149	                    "attempted_sources": source_queries,
  1150	                    "graph_gap": True,
  1151	                    "reason": "; ".join(sorted({e["reason"] for e in errors})) or "no atlas node tied to this source path",
  1152	                }
  1153	            )
  1154	        else:
  1155	            contexts.append({"source": query, "source_queries": source_queries, "nodes": nodes})
  1156	    return {"contexts": contexts, "graph_gaps": gaps}
  1157

  1159	def build_provenance(env: Env, candidate_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1160	    manifest = load_manifest(env)
  1161	    entry = (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).get(candidate_id)
  1162	    if not entry:
  1163	        raise SystemExit(f"error: unknown candidate: {candidate_id}")
  1164	
  1165	    evidence = source_evidence_for_candidate(env, entry)
  1166	    graph_context = graph_context_for_candidate(env, entry)
  1167	    provenance_paths: list[str] = []
  1168	    for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or ["unclassified_target_parameter"]:
  1169	        prompt_payload = dict(entry)
  1170	        prompt_payload["phase_b_parameter_name"] = param
  1171	        phase_b_prompt = render_template(
  1172	            env,
  1173	            "phase_b_provenance_builder.md",
  1174	            {
  1175	                "CANDIDATE_ID": candidate_id,
  1176	                "CANDIDATE_YAML": yaml_block(prompt_payload),
  1177	            },
  1178	        )
  1179	        prompt_path = env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts" / f"{candidate_id}__phase_b__{slug(param)}.md"
  1180	        write_text(prompt_path, phase_b_prompt)
  1181	        payload = {
  1182	            "schema_version": 1,
  1183	            "candidate_id": candidate_id,
  1184	            "parameter_name": param,
  1185	            "dry_run": bool(entry.get("dry_run")),
  1186	            "dry_run_id": entry.get("dry_run_id"),
  1187	            "non_binding": bool(entry.get("dry_run")),
  1188	            "generated_content_kind": "mechanical_evidence_bundle",
  1189	            "agent_prompt_path": env.rel(prompt_path),
  1190	            "agent_synthesis_required": True,
  1191	            "dry_run_fixture": bool(entry.get("dry_run")),
  1192	            "fixture_note": (
  1193	                "Dry-run provenance stores only opened source evidence and graph context. "
  1194	                "Origin claims, constraints, and contradiction findings must be produced by the Phase B agent path."
  1195	            )
  1260	            "PROVENANCE_SLICE": yaml_block(provenance_docs),
  1261	            "BENCHMARKS": yaml_block(load_benchmarks_for_candidate(env, candidate_id)),
  1262	            "GRAPH_CONTEXT": yaml_block(graph_context),
  1263	        },
  1264	    )
  1265	    prompt_path = env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts" / f"{candidate_id}__phase_c_adversarial.md"
  1266	    write_text(prompt_path, prompt)
  1267	    report_path = env.artifact_root / "reports" / f"{candidate_id}__dry_run_prompt_render.md"
  1268	    if entry.get("dry_run"):
  1269	        write_text(
  1270	            report_path,
  1271	            "\n".join(
  1272	                [
  1273	                    "---",
  1274	                    "dry_run: true",
  1275	                    "non_binding: true",
  1276	                    f"candidate_id: {candidate_id}",
  1277	                    "binding_verdict: null",
  1278	                    "adversarial_verdict: null",
  1279	                    "---",
  1280	                    "",
  1281	                    "# Dry-Run Phase C Prompt Render",
  1282	                    "",
  1283	                    "This file records that Phase C prompt assembly completed. It is not an adversarial report and records no verdict.",
  1284	                    "",
  1285	                    f"- prompt: {env.rel(prompt_path)}",
  1286	                ]
  1287	            )
  1288	            + "\n",
  1289	        )
  1290	        entry.setdefault("paths", {})["report"] = env.rel(report_path)
  1291	    entry.setdefault("paths", {})["phase_c_prompt"] = env.rel(prompt_path)
  1292	    transition(entry, "audit_pending")
  1293	    manifest["candidates"][candidate_id] = entry
  1294	    render_fit_file(env, manifest)
  1295	    render_batches(env, manifest)
  1296	    save_manifest(env, manifest)
  1297	    return {"candidate_id": candidate_id, "phase_c_prompt": env.rel(prompt_path), "status": entry["status"]}

  1300	def render_defense_prompt(env: Env, candidate_id: str, parameter: str) -> str:
  1301	    manifest = load_manifest(env)
  1302	    entry = (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).get(candidate_id)
  1303	    if not entry:
  1304	        raise SystemExit(f"error: unknown candidate: {candidate_id}")
  1305	    report_path = entry.get("paths", {}).get("report")
  1306	    report_text = "(no adversarial report path is recorded)"
  1307	    if report_path:
  1308	        p = env.abs_from_rel(report_path)
  1309	        if p.exists():
  1310	            report_text = read_text(p)
  1311	    provenance_docs = []
  1312	    for path_text in entry.get("paths", {}).get("provenance") or []:
  1313	        if slug(parameter) in path_text or parameter in path_text:
  1314	            p = env.abs_from_rel(path_text)
  1315	            if p.exists():
  1316	                provenance_docs.append(load_yaml(p))
  1317	    prompt = render_template(
  1318	        env,
  1319	        "codex_defense.md",
  1320	        {
  1321	            "CANDIDATE_ID": candidate_id,
  1322	            "PARAMETER": parameter,
  1323	            "CANDIDATE_YAML": yaml_block(entry),
  1324	            "ADVERSARIAL_REPORT": report_text.rstrip(),
  1325	            "PROVENANCE_SLICE": yaml_block(provenance_docs),
  1326	            "BENCHMARKS": yaml_block(load_benchmarks_for_candidate(env, candidate_id)),
  1327	        },
  1328	    )
  1329	    prompt_path = env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts" / f"{candidate_id}__defense__{slug(parameter)}.md"
  1330	    write_text(prompt_path, prompt)

  1519	    if not path.exists():

  1522	        shutil.rmtree(path)
  1523	    else:

  1527	def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
  1528	    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
  1529	    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
  1530	        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
  1531	            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
  1532	    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
  1533	        data = load_yaml(path)
  1534	        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
  1535	            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
  1536	    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
  1537	        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
  1538	            continue
  1539	        name = path.name
  1540	        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
  1541	            if name.endswith(suffix):
  1542	                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
  1543	    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
  1544	        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
  1545	            try:
  1546	                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
  1547	            except OSError:
  1548	                continue
  1549	            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
  1550	            if match:
  1551	                ids.add(match.group(1))
  1552	    return ids
  1553	
  1554	
  1555	def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
  1556	    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
  1557	        return False
  1558	    try:
  1559	        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
  1560	    except OSError:
  1561	        return False
  1562	    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text
  1563

    32	
    33	- `init` creates `redteam_adversarial/`, `MANIFEST.yaml`, `fit_insertion_points.yaml`, `benchmarks.yaml`, `BATCHES.md`, and required subdirectories.
    34	- `render-phase-a-prompts --stages NNN ... [--prefix NAME]` renders the four blind Phase A modality prompts only, under `tmp_prompts/`.
    35	- `phase-a-scan --stages NNN ...` runs the broad mechanical Phase A modalities, writes YAML fragments, unions candidates, and renders all four modality prompts plus the completeness-critic prompt.
    36	- `phase-b-build <candidate_id>` builds a mechanical parameter-value evidence bundle, renders the Phase B provenance-builder prompt, and updates manifest status to `provenance_built`.
    37	- `phase-c-render <candidate_id>` renders the adversarial prompt under `redteam_adversarial/tmp_prompts/` and updates status to `audit_pending`.
    38	- `set-status <candidate_id> <status> [--note TEXT]` advances a candidate through the state machine under the manifest lock; `blocked` is reachable from any state.
    39	- `codex-defense <candidate_id> <parameter> [iter]` renders a defense prompt and invokes Codex, resuming the session keyed by parameter.
    40	- `graph <show|neighborhood|paths|source> ...` wraps `graph/query_graph.py` using the configured graph path.
    41	- `status` or `summary` prints manifest counts and dry-run state.
    42	- `candidate-info <candidate_id>` dumps one manifest entry.
    43	- `dry-run --stages 003 104 105` exercises Phase A -> Phase B -> Phase C prompt rendering without binding verdicts.
    44	- `purge-dry-run <id|all>` removes dry-run manifest entries and dry-run artifacts in one step.
    45	
    46	## Runbooks
    47	
    48	### Phase A Scan
    49	
    50	For Step 3 real campaign work, do not hand-select a family of stages or parameters. The real sweep is the full configured stage range, currently 001 through 253. Render the blind prompts for the campaign band first:
    51	
    52	```bash
    53	$AA render-phase-a-prompts --stages $(seq -f "%03g" 1 253) --prefix campaign_001_253
    54	```
    55	
    56	Launch four clean agents, one per rendered prompt: numeric-literal, claim-label, graph, and existing-provenance. Each agent remains blind to the other modality outputs and emits only a YAML fragment. The mechanical `phase-a-scan` path is broad and not seeded to any parameter family; it provides the union baseline and records per-modality attribution. Agent fragment incorporation for Step 3 must preserve the same fragment schema and blindness rule.
    57	
    58	For a bounded scan or dry-run fixture:
    59	
    60	1. Run:
    61	   ```bash
    62	   $AA phase-a-scan --stages 003 104 105
    63	   ```
    64	2. Inspect `redteam_adversarial/phase_a_fragments/*.yaml` and `redteam_adversarial/tmp_prompts/*_phase_a_*.md`. Each modality is blind to the others.
    65	3. Inspect `redteam_adversarial/fit_insertion_points.yaml`. The union preserves `modality_attribution` and `file_line_citations`.
    66	4. Read the rendered completeness-critic prompt under `redteam_adversarial/tmp_prompts/` and launch a clean agent only for the real campaign sweep.
    67	
    68	### Phase B Build
    69	
    70	1. Choose a scanned candidate:
    71	   ```bash
    72	   $AA candidate-info <candidate_id>
    73	   ```
    74	2. Run:
    75	   ```bash
    76	   $AA phase-b-build <candidate_id>
    77	   ```
    78	3. Verify the generated `provenance/*.yaml` is parameter-value provenance only. It is a mechanical evidence bundle, not interpretive synthesis.
    79	4. Give the rendered `tmp_prompts/*__phase_b__*.md` prompt to a clean provenance agent. Every attribution must cite the per-stage `notes/` source. If origin claims contradict each other, keep the contradiction as a finding. If graph lookup misses a source, keep `graph_gap`.
    80	
    81	### Phase C Batch
    82	
    83	1. Ensure candidate status is `provenance_built`.
    84	2. Render:
    85	   ```bash
    86	   $AA phase-c-render <candidate_id>
    87	   ```
    88	3. Give the rendered prompt to a clean adversarial agent. The prompt includes the frozen directive, primary sources, provenance slice, benchmark entries, and graph context.
    89	4. If the adversarial verdict is NO, archive the report and run `$AA set-status <candidate_id> audited`.
    90	5. If the adversarial verdict is YES, run `$AA set-status <candidate_id> defense_pending` and run Codex defense per parameter.
    91	6. Pause for `/compact` between Phase C batches. This is context hygiene, not a user gate.
    92	
    93	### Codex Defense
    94	
    95	Defense sessions are keyed per parameter. The same parameter recurring across stages resumes the same Codex session.
    96	
    97	```bash
    98	$AA codex-defense <candidate_id> chi_Q 1
    99	```
   100	
   101	The wrapper captures `codex_session_id:` from Codex output and stores it at:
   102	
   103	```yaml
   104	codex_session:
   105	  by_parameter:
   106	    chi_Q:
   107	      session_id:
   108	      log_paths: []
   109	```
   110	
   111	The defense log must contain per-finding `DEFEND`, `CONCEDE`, or `PARTIAL` outcomes. A zero-exit Codex wrapper without parsed outcomes is recorded as `defense_pending` and fails informatively.
   112	
   113	### Adjudication
   114	
   115	Use `prompts/adjudication_consult.md` for the Claude+Codex consult record under `redteam_adversarial/verdicts/`. The signed-off outcomes are `FIND_STANDS`, `FIND_FAILS`, or `PARTIAL`. User escalation happens only for `FIND_STANDS` or conceptual changes, per `docs/adversarial_audit_execution_plan.md`.
   116	
   117	### Dry Run
   118	
   119	Run exactly:
   120	
   121	```bash
   122	$AA dry-run --stages 003 104 105
   123	```

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:

+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)

+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
     query_graph = env.config_path_value("query_graph")
     graph_path = env.config_path_value("atlas_graph")
+    errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for query in source_queries:
+        cmd = ["timeout", "600", "python3", str(query_graph), "--graph", str(graph_path), "source", query, "--format", "json"]
+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:
+            errors.append({"source": query, "reason": f"query_graph exit {proc.returncode}", "stderr": proc.stderr.strip()[:500]})
+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
+    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
+    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
+        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):

+        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
+            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
+    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
+        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
+            continue
+        name = path.name
+        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
+            if name.endswith(suffix):
+                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
+    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
+        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):

+            except OSError:
+                continue
+            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
+            if match:
+                ids.add(match.group(1))
+    return ids

+def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
+    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
+        return False
+    try:

+    except OSError:
+        return False
+    return "dry_run: true" in text or "dry_run_id:" in text or "non_binding: true" in text

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def query_graph_source(env: Env, source_queries: list[str]) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:

+        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=env.repo_root, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
+        if proc.returncode != 0:

+            continue
+        payload = json.loads(proc.stdout or "{}")
+        nodes = payload.get("nodes") or []
+        if nodes:
+            return nodes, []
+        errors.append({"source": query, "reason": "no atlas node tied to this source path"})
+    return [], errors

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+    if value and value not in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        params.append(value)

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+

+def validate_manual_transition(current: str | None, target: str) -> None:
+    if target not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid candidate status: {target}")
+    current = current or "pending"
+    if current not in STATE_MACHINE:
+        raise SystemExit(f"error: candidate has invalid current status: {current}")
+    if target == current:
+        return
+    if target == "blocked":
+        return
+    current_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(current)
+    target_i = STATE_MACHINE.index(target)
+    if target_i == current_i + 1:
+        return
+    raise SystemExit(f"error: invalid status transition: {current} -> {target}")
+

+def clean_param_piece(text: str) -> str:
+    text = text.replace("\\rm", "")
+    text = text.replace("\\mathrm", "")
+    text = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", text)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", text).strip("_")

+def normalized_param_name(text: str) -> str | None:
+    text = text.strip().strip("`")
+    text = text.replace("\\", "")
+    text = text.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    text = text.replace("^", "_")
+    text = clean_param_piece(text)
+    if not text or text in PARAMETER_DENYLIST:
+        return None
+    if len(text) == 1 and text.isalpha():
+        return None
+    return text

+def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
+    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+        upper = line.upper()
+        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
+            continue
+        field_match = re.search(
+            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
+            line,
+        )
+        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
+        match = field_match or bullet_match
+        if match:
+            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
+    return outcomes
+
